title: A Dynamic Likelihood Approach to Filtering for Advection-Diffusion Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2406.06837v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A Bayesian data assimilation scheme is formulated for advection-dominated advective and diffusive evolutionary problems, based upon the Dynamic Likelihood (DLF) approach to filtering. The DLF was developed specifically for hyperbolic problems -waves-, and in this paper, it is extended via a split step formulation, to handle advection-diffusion problems. In the dynamic likelihood approach, observations and their statistics are used to propagate probabilities along characteristics, evolving the likelihood in time. The estimate posterior thus inherits phase information. For advection-diffusion the advective part of the time evolution is handled on the basis of observations alone, while the diffusive part is informed through the model as well as observations. translated_title: 平流-扩散动力学滤波的动态似然方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：本文基于动态似然（DLF）滤波方法，为平流主导的平流-扩散演化问题制定了一种贝叶斯数据同化方案。DLF最初是为双曲问题（波动）开发的，本文通过分裂步公式将其扩展到处理平流-扩散问题。在动态似然方法中，观测及其统计信息用于沿特征传播概率，随时间演化似然函数，从而估计后验继承了相位信息。对于平流-扩散问题，时间演化的平流部分仅基于观测处理，而扩散部分则通过模型和观测共同获取信息。我们预期并在此展示，在平流主导的问题中，DLF方法比其他同化方法产生更好的估计，尤其是在观测条件有限的情况下。
tldr: 本文通过分裂步公式扩展动态似然滤波方法，用于平流-扩散动力学，在平流主导问题中利用观测沿特征传播概率，显著提升估计精度，尤其在观测稀疏时。
en_tdlr: This paper extends the Dynamic Likelihood Filter via a split-step formulation for advection-diffusion dynamics, leveraging observation-driven probability propagation along characteristics to achieve superior estimation accuracy in advection-dominated problems, especially with sparse observations.
